0.label: Face Image Forensics and Security
0.description: Research on detecting, generating, and defending against synthetic/manipulated facial imagery, encompassing deepfake detection, face recognition security, and AI-generated image forensics.
subtopics: Deepfake and AI-generated image detection methods
Adversarial robustness and attacks on face recognition systems
Synthetic data generation for face recognition training
Frequency-domain and artifact-based forensic analysis
Privacy-preserving and ethical facial image processing

1.label: Adversarial Attacks and Robustness
1.description: Research on adversarial vulnerabilities, attack methods, and defense mechanisms for deep learning models across diverse data modalities and application domains.
subtopics: Adversarial attack methods and transferability (images, point clouds, video)
Adversarial training and robust defense frameworks
Certified robustness and randomized smoothing
Data poisoning and model security threats
Adversarial robustness in knowledge distillation

2.label: Graph Neural Networks Research
2.description: This cluster encompasses research on graph neural network architectures, their theoretical properties, scalability, robustness, and applications across diverse graph-structured data including dynamic, temporal, and heterophilic graphs.
subtopics: GNN architectures and expressiveness (spectral methods, transformers, message passing improvements)
Dynamic and temporal graph modeling and benchmarking
Robustness, adversarial attacks, and uncertainty in GNNs
Scalability and efficiency for large-scale graphs (distillation, local solvers, foundation models)
Graph learning for specific tasks (link prediction, subgraph mining, graph edit distance, network tomography)

3.label: AI for Molecular and Biological Sciences
3.description: Machine learning and deep learning methods applied to molecular generation, protein engineering, drug discovery, and genomic analysis across biological and chemical domains.
subtopics: Molecular conformation and structure generation
Protein property prediction and engineering
Drug discovery and therapeutic optimization
Genomic sequence modeling and prediction
Retrosynthesis and chemical reaction planning

4.label: Causal Inference and Discovery Methods
4.description: Research advancing causal reasoning, causal discovery, and counterfactual inference through machine learning methods applied across diverse domains.
subtopics: Counterfactual reasoning and explanation generation
Causal discovery algorithms and identifiability
Causal representation learning with latent variables
Causal inference for treatment effect estimation
Applications of causality in neuroscience, NLP, and explainability

5.label: Federated Learning Privacy and Optimization
5.description: Research on federated and decentralized learning focusing on communication efficiency, data heterogeneity, privacy preservation, robustness to attacks, and convergence optimization.
subtopics: Communication efficiency and quantization in federated learning
Privacy preservation and data leakage mitigation
Robustness against adversarial and poisoning attacks
Non-IID data heterogeneity and convergence guarantees
Decentralized optimization over network topologies

6.label: LLM Hallucination Detection and Mitigation
6.description: Research on detecting, understanding, and mitigating factual hallucinations in large language models and vision-language models across diverse tasks and modalities.
subtopics: Decoding strategies to reduce hallucinations
Hallucination detection via internal representations and probing
Vision-language model object and relation hallucination
Fact-checking and claim verification pipelines
Theoretical frameworks for hallucination detection feasibility

7.label: Environmental Remote Sensing with AI
7.description: AI and deep learning methods applied to geospatial, remote sensing, and environmental monitoring tasks including land cover mapping, underwater imaging, and ecological assessment.
subtopics: Hyperspectral and satellite image analysis with state-space models and transformers
Underwater image enhancement, marine species detection, and coral reef monitoring
3D reconstruction and phenotyping using NeRFs for plants and trees
Geospatial foundation models and self-supervised learning for Earth observation
Land cover classification and terrain mapping with deep learning

8.label: Explainability and Interpretability in AI
8.description: This cluster investigates methods, frameworks, and theoretical foundations for explaining, interpreting, and understanding the decisions and internal mechanisms of machine learning models.
subtopics: Post-hoc explanation methods (LIME, SHAP, gradient-based saliency)
Interpretable model architectures (Concept Bottleneck Models, decision trees)
Mechanistic interpretability via sparse autoencoders
Formal and theoretical foundations of explainability (complexity, abductive/counterfactual explanations)
Human-centered evaluation of AI explanations

9.label: Sentiment and Emotion Analysis
9.description: Research on detecting, classifying, and analyzing sentiments and emotions from text, speech, and multimodal data using machine learning and large language models.
subtopics: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversations
Aspect-based and fine-grained sentiment analysis
Low-resource and cross-lingual sentiment/emotion analysis
Large language models for sentiment and emotion tasks
Emotion-aware fusion and modality conflict handling

10.label: Anomaly Detection Methods and Applications
10.description: This cluster encompasses research on novel anomaly detection algorithms and frameworks across diverse data modalities including images, video, time series, graphs, and tensors, with applications spanning industrial inspection, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and surveillance.
subtopics: Visual and industrial defect detection (image-based anomaly detection, manufacturing quality inspection)
Video anomaly detection and localization (surveillance, temporal-spatial reasoning)
Time series and streaming anomaly detection (sensor monitoring, evaluation metrics)
Graph and structured data anomaly detection (dynamic graphs, federated learning settings)
Unsupervised and zero-shot anomaly detection frameworks (self-supervised learning, foundation model reasoning)

11.label: AI in Medical Image Analysis
11.description: Research on applying deep learning, foundation models, and advanced AI techniques to medical imaging and clinical data for improved diagnosis, segmentation, and health monitoring.
subtopics: Medical image segmentation (brain tumors, fetal head, histopathology)
Non-invasive physiological monitoring and diagnostics (ICP, rPPG, thermography)
Foundation models and knowledge distillation for medical imaging
Multimodal and language-augmented clinical AI (VQA, clinical notes, MLLMs)
Ethics, reliability, and responsible deployment of AI in healthcare

12.label: Video Understanding and Reasoning
12.description: Research on computational methods for understanding, analyzing, reasoning about, and evaluating video content through multimodal models and language integration.
subtopics: Video question answering and temporal reasoning
Video-language model adaptation and efficiency
Video quality assessment and generation evaluation
Video temporal grounding and dense captioning
Benchmarks for long-form and complex video understanding

13.label: Robot Localization and Odometry Systems
13.description: Research on sensor-based localization, odometry, and mapping methods for autonomous robots and vehicles operating in challenging environments.
subtopics: Visual and LiDAR odometry and SLAM systems
Indoor and GPS-denied localization techniques
Multi-sensor fusion and temporal calibration
Active perception and perception-aware planning
Inertial navigation and drift mitigation

14.label: Image Restoration and Super-Resolution
14.description: This cluster focuses on advancing deep learning methods for image restoration tasks including super-resolution, low-light enhancement, deblurring, and deraining, leveraging architectures such as diffusion models, transformers, and state space models.
subtopics: Image super-resolution with diffusion models and efficient inference
Low-light image enhancement and exposure correction
Vision Mamba/State Space Models for visual tasks
Transformer-based architectures for image restoration
Task-driven and adaptive computational resource allocation

15.label: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting
15.description: Research advancing methods for time series forecasting, classification, imputation, and representation learning through deep learning architectures, foundation models, and novel analytical frameworks.
subtopics: Foundation models and pre-training for time series
Multivariate time series forecasting architectures
Time series classification and representation learning
Data imputation and handling missing values
Uncertainty quantification and robustness in forecasting

16.label: Optimization Algorithms and Applications
16.description: This cluster encompasses research on metaheuristic, evolutionary, and learning-based optimization algorithms and their application to combinatorial, multi-objective, and real-world optimization problems.
subtopics: Learning-based methods for combinatorial optimization (neural solvers, reinforcement learning, LLMs)
Metaheuristic and evolutionary algorithm design and analysis
Vehicle routing and logistics optimization
Multi-objective and multimodal optimization
Constraint programming and mathematical optimization modeling

17.label: Human Action Recognition and Detection
17.description: Research on recognizing, detecting, and segmenting human actions in videos and sensor data using deep learning, transformers, and multimodal approaches.
subtopics: Temporal action detection and segmentation in videos
Skeleton-based and pose-informed action recognition
Multimodal and sensor-based activity recognition
Large-scale datasets and benchmarks for action understanding
Knowledge distillation and label-efficient learning for HAR

18.label: 3D Human Modeling and Animation
18.description: Research on reconstructing, tracking, animating, and understanding 3D humans (including faces, hands, bodies, and their interactions with objects and scenes) from various sensor inputs.
subtopics: 3D human pose estimation and motion capture from diverse sensors
Talking head and avatar generation with neural rendering
Human-object and human-scene interaction reconstruction
Diffusion models for human motion and video synthesis
3D face and hand reconstruction from monocular images

19.label: Transformer Efficiency and Architecture Analysis
19.description: Research on improving transformer-based language model efficiency through memory optimization, architectural innovations, and theoretical analysis of attention mechanisms and representations.
subtopics: KV cache compression and quantization for long-context inference
Alternative attention mechanisms and architectural designs for efficiency
Theoretical analysis of transformer learning dynamics and expressivity
Long-context processing and memory-augmented architectures
Internal representations and mechanistic interpretability of transformers

20.label: Controllable Video Generation Models
20.description: Research on advancing video generation through diffusion models with improved controllability, efficiency, motion control, and customization capabilities.
subtopics: Motion control and trajectory-guided video generation
Efficient video diffusion model acceleration and compression
Subject-driven and customizable video synthesis
Multi-shot and compositional video generation
Training-free and zero-shot video generation methods

21.label: Diffusion Models for Image Generation
21.description: Research advancing diffusion-based generative models for image synthesis, editing, and manipulation with improved quality, efficiency, and controllability.
subtopics: Efficient diffusion training and distillation methods
Controllable and layout-guided image generation
Image composition, inpainting, and editing
Sampling, score matching, and theoretical foundations
Personalization and identity-preserving generation

22.label: Multimodal Vision-Language Models & Learning
22.description: Research on advancing multimodal models that integrate visual and linguistic information for improved understanding, reasoning, representation alignment, and efficient deployment.
subtopics: Vision-language model efficiency and token pruning
Multimodal benchmarks and evaluation frameworks
Cross-modal alignment and representation learning
Balanced and imbalanced multimodal learning
Prompt tuning and zero-shot transfer for vision-language tasks

23.label: Robot Learning and Embodied AI
23.description: Research on enabling robots to perceive, plan, and act in complex environments through learning-based methods, foundation models, and human interaction.
subtopics: Vision-language models for robotic planning and control
Learning visuomotor policies and representations for manipulation
Human-robot interaction and collaborative systems
Navigation, safety, and motion planning in dynamic environments
Scalable data annotation and pre-training for robot learning

24.label: AI for Weather and Environmental Forecasting
24.description: This cluster encompasses research applying artificial intelligence and machine learning methods to weather prediction, environmental monitoring, natural disaster assessment, and energy systems influenced by environmental conditions.
subtopics: AI-based weather and climate prediction models
Natural disaster damage assessment using deep learning and remote sensing
Renewable energy forecasting and power grid management
Ocean and marine environment monitoring with ML
Compound flood and extreme event forecasting

25.label: Neural Networks for Physics-Based Modeling
25.description: Research at the intersection of deep learning and physics, focusing on neural network architectures and methods for solving differential equations, learning dynamical systems, and scientific computing.
subtopics: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for solving PDEs
Neural operators and surrogate models for scientific simulation
Symmetry, conservation laws, and physical constraints as inductive biases
Probabilistic and generative approaches for equation discovery and PDE solving
Dynamical systems learning and stability analysis in neural architectures

26.label: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Mixture-of-Experts
26.description: Research on efficient adaptation of large-scale models through parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (especially LoRA variants) and Mixture-of-Experts architectures for improved scalability and performance.
subtopics: LoRA variants and low-rank adaptation improvements
Mixture-of-Experts architecture design, routing, and scaling laws
Memory and compute efficiency in fine-tuning large models
Expert pruning, compression, and inference optimization for MoE
Theoretical analysis and benchmarking of PEFT expressiveness and limitations

27.label: Recommender Systems Research Advances
27.description: Research on improving recommender systems through multimodal fusion, sequential modeling, large language models, user behavior understanding, and evaluation methodologies.
subtopics: Sequential and temporal recommendation models
LLM and multimodal integration for recommendations
Conversational recommender systems and evaluation
Data sparsity, denoising, and cold-start solutions
E-commerce search, CTR prediction, and re-ranking

28.label: Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
28.description: Research on integrating knowledge graphs, retrieval mechanisms, and language models to improve information retrieval, question answering, and knowledge-grounded reasoning.
subtopics: Knowledge graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Knowledge graph embedding and representation learning
Natural language to query translation (SPARQL/GQL)
Information retrieval and reranking techniques
Text chunking, query expansion, and RAG pipeline optimization

29.label: Optimization and Uncertainty in Deep Learning
29.description: Research advancing neural network training optimization algorithms, uncertainty quantification methods, and theoretically grounded improvements to deep learning efficiency and reliability.
subtopics: Adaptive optimizer design and improvements (Adam variants, Muon, conjugate gradient methods)
Uncertainty quantification and calibration in neural networks and LLMs
Gradient analysis, clipping, and training stability techniques
Biologically inspired and neuromorphic computing approaches
Learning rate scaling, hyperparameter transfer, and convergence theory

30.label: Neural Network Compression Methods
30.description: Research on techniques for compressing and accelerating neural networks, including pruning, quantization, and sparsity methods, to enable efficient deployment on resource-constrained devices.
subtopics: Weight quantization and low-bit representation for LLMs and CNNs
Structured and unstructured pruning techniques
Neural architecture search and efficient model design
Memory-efficient deployment and hardware co-design
Sparsity learning and lottery ticket hypothesis

31.label: 3D Scene Reconstruction and Generation
31.description: Research advancing 3D scene and object reconstruction, generation, and representation through neural rendering, Gaussian splatting, diffusion models, and structured decomposition methods.
subtopics: 3D Gaussian Splatting and neural radiance fields for scene reconstruction
Text/image-conditioned 3D content and scene generation
Structured and compositional 3D scene understanding and decomposition
3D scene layout generation and spatial reasoning
Surface reconstruction and geometry optimization techniques

32.label: Autonomous Driving AI Systems
32.description: Research on AI and machine learning methods for perception, prediction, planning, and safety in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems.
subtopics: Trajectory prediction and motion forecasting
End-to-end planning and reasoning for self-driving
Traffic safety, simulation, and domain adaptation
Vehicle perception and detection methods
Human factors and adoption of autonomous vehicles

33.label: 3D Point Cloud Perception Methods
33.description: Research on deep learning methods for processing, understanding, and analyzing 3D point clouds and multi-sensor data, with emphasis on autonomous driving, scene understanding, and efficient architectures.
subtopics: Autonomous driving perception and multi-sensor fusion
Point cloud classification and segmentation architectures
3D object detection and open-vocabulary recognition
Point cloud preprocessing, registration, and denoising
Bird's-Eye View representation and scene understanding

34.label: LLM Safety and Content Moderation
34.description: Research on large language model vulnerabilities, jailbreak attacks, harmful content detection, and safety alignment across textual and multimodal settings.
subtopics: Jailbreak attacks and adversarial prompting against LLMs
Hate speech, offensive language, and harmful meme detection
LLM safety alignment, refusal behavior, and defense mechanisms
Cross-lingual and low-resource content moderation
Deception, misinformation, and misuse of LLM capabilities

35.label: Language, LLMs, and Linguistic Diversity
35.description: Research on large language models and NLP techniques applied to multilingual, low-resource, and linguistically diverse language processing challenges.
subtopics: Low-resource and endangered language NLP
Multilingual LLM development and evaluation
Linguistic typology, cognition, and language structure
Machine translation and parallel data for under-resourced languages
Cultural and sociopragmatic aspects of language modeling

36.label: Reinforcement Learning Methods & Applications
36.description: This cluster covers diverse advances in reinforcement learning, including model-based methods, offline RL, multi-agent coordination, safety constraints, and novel algorithmic frameworks for improved sample efficiency, robustness, and real-world applicability.
subtopics: Offline and offline-to-online reinforcement learning
Safe and constrained reinforcement learning
Multi-agent reinforcement learning and communication
Model-based RL and sample efficiency
Robustness, adaptation, and policy representation

37.label: AI Agents: Frameworks and Evaluation
37.description: Research on the design, coordination, tool integration, planning capabilities, and evaluation of AI agent systems, particularly those powered by large language models.
subtopics: Multi-agent communication, coordination, and orchestration
Tool augmentation and external integration for LLM-based agents
Agent planning, reasoning, and decision-making
Benchmarking, evaluation, and operational maintenance of agent systems
Agentic frameworks and architectural designs

38.label: LLM Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning
38.description: Research on enhancing large language model reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning, reward optimization, and efficient inference strategies.
subtopics: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for LLM reasoning
Reward hacking mitigation and policy optimization in RLHF
Efficient reasoning and test-time compute optimization
LLM reasoning analysis, interpretability, and evaluation
Training data, verification, and alignment strategies for LLMs
